# T-3: Preserve setup persistence boundaries

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Ensure candidate discovery does not persist official plugin state, while official preset selection saves public official state without leaking local private plugin config.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R3 base-only setup does not write official source/package state.
- R4 official preset selection writes official source/package state and validates the chain.
- R6 private local plugin entries remain only in `.senti/config.local.json`.

## Implementation Notes
Reuse or adjust `ensureSetupOfficialPresetState()` so it can use the same resolved official source as candidate discovery while writing only public official state.

## Test Strategy
Add spec-local behavior-level tests under `specs/297-setup-official-presets/` with `*** spec: R<N> ...` headers for base-only no-persistence, official preset persistence, chain validation, and config.local separation.
